mapper.select: SELECT credential.algorithm, credential.master_key_version, credential.data_key_nonce, credential.encrypted_data_key, credential.ciphertext_nonce, credential.ciphertext FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection connection JOIN model_runtime.platform_provider_connection_credential credential ON credential.platform_provider_connection_id = connection.id WHERE connection.id = #{id} AND connection.scope = 'PLATFORM' AND connection.version = #{revision} AND connection.status = 'VERIFIED' AND connection.last_probe_succeeded = TRUE AND connection.last_probed_at <= #{now} AND connection.last_probed_at > CAST(#{now} AS TIMESTAMPTZ) - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND credential.credential_purpose = 'INFERENCE_API_KEY' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_runtime.platform_provider_connection_publication publication WHERE publication.connection_id = connection.id AND publication.connection_revision = connection.version)
